name: What is the process for starting an interior renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting an interior renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we move to the design phase, where layouts and material selections are finalized. Once designs are approved and permits obtained, construction begins. We manage project timelines, coordinate subcontractors, and provide regular updates until completion and final walkthrough. Our goal is a smooth and transparent experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process starts with consultation, followed by design, permitting, and construction. We manage the project through to completion.
